name: work-laptop-camera-light
goal: El Gato light follows the work laptop camera while docked; DnD unchanged.

userStories.title: Helpers
acceptanceCriteria: Both files define one input_boolean each with name and icon, no initial:
Basenames unique across packages/

userStories.title: On automation
userStories.description: Add work camera + docked source to office_camera_light_on.
acceptanceCriteria: Triggers: work camera on for 2s, docked on; existing kept
Conditions: occupied, presence office, El Gato off, or(Mac camera on, work camera on AND docked on) with alias
Action uses target:; initial_state/id/alias unchanged
No john_dnd reference

userStories.title: Off automation
userStories.description: Add work camera + docked source to office_camera_light_off.
acceptanceCriteria: Triggers: work camera off for 4s, docked off; existing kept
Conditions: Mac camera not on, not(work camera on AND docked on), El Gato on; no state off on sources
Action uses target:; initial_state/id/alias unchanged; header gets 1-2 line description
No john_dnd reference

userStories.title: Tests
acceptanceCriteria: Helpers exist with no initial
On triggers/conditions reference both new entities; or contains Mac camera
Off triggers include both; no state off on sources; not covers work pair
No john_dnd in camera-light files; actions use target:
pytest tests/ passes

userStories.title: Docs
acceptanceCriteria: ROOMS.md El Gato line updated
README + LEARNINGS describe new booleans and john_dnd not driving light
PEOPLE.md tree lists new helpers
No PII

userStories.title: Laptop contract handoff
acceptanceCriteria: Entity ids, on/off semantics, off on sleep/exit, re-sync on wake/start, REST shape with placeholders
HA deploys first; failed calls must not crash script
